## Existing systems

| System | Role today | Disposition (where stated) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Specialists' external calendars | every Specialist's working schedule lives in a personal calendar, in whatever tool they already use; providers not yet named → open | retained, not replaced — the network stated it plainly at presale | canvas: Third-Party Connections · presale brief |
| Phone lines at the clinics | today's booking channel; reception desks take calls 09:00–18:00 and ~30% of calls go unanswered → P-1 | superseded as the primary booking channel → O-1 | canvas: Problems P-1 · kickoff notes · call 2026-07-14 |

No booking software exists today — nothing digital to migrate on the booking
side `[presale brief]`.

## Organizational landscape

- A single network of eight clinics; the COO owns the budget and brought the
  request, and is the sponsor `[presale brief · canvas: Customers]`
- Specialists each keep their own calendar in whatever tool they already use;
  there is no shared scheduling system across the network `[presale brief]`
- Online payment is a separate, later initiative — roadmap E-07; no payment
  surface sits inside this product's scope `[kickoff notes · canvas: Objectives O-1]`
